=====BEGIN https://docs.acme.test/widgets/overview=====
Widgets Overview

Acme Widgets let you compose reusable UI blocks. Each widget is scoped to a
workspace and can be exported as JSON.
=====END https://docs.acme.test/widgets/overview=====
=====BEGIN https://docs.acme.test/widgets/syntax-reference=====
Widget Syntax Reference

A widget definiton must declare a `type` field.
=====END https://docs.acme.test/widgets/syntax-reference=====
